skill.name: exa-search
skill.description: Use Exa to guide semantic web search, similar content discovery, category-based search, and structured research workflows.
skill.summary: Use Exa for semantic search, similar content discovery, and structured research workflows.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The two static findings are false positives. The installation command is documentation inside a Markdown bash block, and the hardcoded URL is a public GitHub reference. No prompt injection or semantic security issue was found in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: The flagged lines are a Markdown fenced bash example showing an installation command, not executable skill code. No script, hook, or user-controlled command execution is present in SKILL.md.
The hardcoded URL is a public GitHub documentation link in the Examples section. It does not trigger a network request or transmit data from the user environment.

content.value_statement: Researchers often need more than keyword search when finding related pages or source clusters. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to use Exa for semantic search and structured research.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use Exa for semantic or embeddings-based search.
Guides similar content discovery tasks for related pages and articles.
Supports category-oriented research for companies, people, and research papers.
Reminds users to configure an Exa API key before use.
Points users to upstream examples and troubleshooting resources.
limitations: Requires an Exa API key and a compatible agent environment.
Does not include executable integration code in this package.
Depends on upstream Exa service availability and API permissions.
Search results require human review for accuracy and source quality.

use_cases.title: Market Research Discovery
use_cases.description: Find semantically related company pages, competitor articles, and category sources for a market scan.

use_cases.title: Research Paper Exploration
use_cases.description: Search for papers and technical sources that match a concept instead of a narrow keyword list.

use_cases.title: Content Similarity Review
use_cases.description: Discover pages similar to a known article, landing page, or topic brief for comparison work.

prompt_templates.title: Start Semantic Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Use exa-search to find relevant sources about [topic]. Focus on semantic matches, then summarize the strongest themes and useful links.

prompt_templates.title: Find Similar Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Use exa-search to find pages similar to [URL or article]. Group results by angle, audience, and likely usefulness.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Category
prompt_templates.prompt: Use exa-search to research companies in [market]. Prioritize official sites, funding pages, competitor lists, and current product pages.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Source Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Use exa-search to create a structured research map for [topic]. Compare papers, expert commentary, company pages, and recent analysis.

output_examples.input: Find semantic sources about private AI agents for enterprise software.
output: A source list grouped by product pages, technical articles, and market analysis.
A concise summary of recurring themes and gaps.
Recommended follow-up searches for deeper research.

output_examples.input: Find pages similar to a competitor article about developer search tools.
output_examples.output: The response groups similar pages by product positioning, technical depth, and audience, with notes on why each source is relevant.

output_examples.input: Research papers about vector search evaluation.
output: A curated list of paper-focused sources matched by concept.
Short relevance notes for each result.
Suggested query refinements for methods, benchmarks, and datasets.

best_practices: Define the search intent, audience, and source type before asking for results.
Configure the Exa API key through environment variables or approved secrets storage.
Ask for source grouping and verification notes when results influence decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not use broad prompts that omit topic, region, or source type.
Do not treat search summaries as verified facts without checking sources.
Do not expose API keys or private data inside prompts.

faq.question: What is exa-search?
faq.answer: exa-search helps agents use Exa for semantic search, similar content discovery, and structured research.

faq.question: Does it require an Exa API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill expects an Exa API key configured in the agent environment.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it find similar pages?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is designed for similar content discovery when a topic, page, or article is provided.

faq.question: Does it replace source verification?
faq.answer: No. Users should review sources, dates, and claims before relying on search results.

faq.question: Does this package include executable code?
faq.answer: No. The scanned package contains prompt guidance in SKILL.md and no executable integration files.
